sourceClaims.claim: Dashboard.svg directly establishes grouped vertical bar, grid, tooltip, series paint, and wide chart specimen geometry recorded in the source matrix

Stable identity, keyboard behavior, legend toggles, semantic table, responsive overflow and arbitrary dataset layout are repository decisions. Nine tones and source density/inspection paint derive from Dashboard.svg.
Nine 24x200 default/muted bar variants with width-specific top contours are directly observed in Dashboard.svg.
The decorative palette factory and quantitative renderer share one clipped-mark implementation; decorative swatches are not controller roots.

findings.description: Zero values retain zero-height paint and use a transparent 12-unit SVG hit and focus target; this interaction geometry is a repository implementation decision, not a source token.
Pointer departure dismisses hover inspection when legend focus is present while preserving tooltip ownership by a focused chart datum.

knownLimitations: Source presets expose measured density; arbitrary dataset geometry remains a repository decision.
Filters, date preparation, export and dashboard editing remain consumer-owned.
